designReference: Use case: stylized-concept. Production sprite artwork for the 'Mari loves Dottore' complete appearance pack. Strict identity/style reference: existing Professor Mari attached. Preserve exact blonde voluminous shoulder-length curls/cowlick, bright BLUE eyes, BLACK rectangular glasses, navy hoodie, charcoal trousers, black boots, adult chibi proportions, head about 45% of height. Same gently shaded pixel art, crisp square clusters and limited palette; no smooth anime/vector rendering. The only permanent outfit additions: small CYAN HEART enamel pin on her hoodie chest and thin cyan wrist ribbon; warm blush. Recurring Dottore miniature PLUSH: recognizable Genshin Impact Il Dottore, wavy pale cyan hair, BLACK angular beak-shaped eye mask with teal accents, white high-collared coat with dark fur shoulder trim and navy details. Plush proportions, never a living second person. Mari remains the protagonist, never gains cyan hair or a mask. Four equal-width cells in ONE horizontal 2048x768 strip, same camera, character scale, foot baseline, all props within cells with generous padding. Genuine transparent alpha background; no scenery behind sprites, floor, gradient, glow haze, ground shadow, labels, separators, captions, lettering, logos or watermark. Each sheet tells ONE connected chronological short story with beginning/action/obstacle/payoff; same props and colors persist. All page marks abstract, no readable text. This is the CANONICAL portrait reference strip, not a story. Four fullbody poses: 1 neutral happy idle, Mari gently holds the small Dottore plush against her chest, glasses eyes OPEN. 2 EXACT same stance and plush placement, ONLY eyes CLOSED in a blink. 3 Mari holds a small folded paper map, same Dottore plush clipped visibly on her belt, curious face. 4 Mari shrugs mildly with palms up, same Dottore plush clipped on her belt, sheepish face. Exact same clothing/pin/ribbon/hair in all four. No other props.
alphaEdit: Use case: background-extraction. Edit this exact four-pose sprite sheet. Keep every character pixel, costume, plush, expression and position exactly unchanged. Remove ALL brown/gray background and colored haze, including the gaps between arms/body, between legs and between four poses. Output genuinely TRANSPARENT alpha throughout every background area, no opaque or translucent backdrop, glow, floor, shadow or gradient. If compositing guidance needed, use flat solid bright #00ff00 behind isolated hard-edged sprites, never brown/black studio background. Preserve four equal cells in horizontal strip.
processing: Nearest-neighbor normalize four-frame sheets to 512x192 with alpha preserved; extract four canonical portrait cells and normalize pixel scale.
